summary: XCHG Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 30, 2026, reporting receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice for failing to meet the minimum $1.00 bid price requirement for 30 consecutive days. The company has 180 days, until December 21, 2026, to regain compliance. No impact on operations or SEC reporting. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of a listing standard deficiency, not a special situation.
